reviews.title: Stylish slippers
reviews.text:
The (in)consistency keeps on with the Downshifter series.

Basically, they are good looking slippers and comfortable too. As with all Nike shoes, they are stylish and expected to be very durable - they wear evenly, making their lifespan very long.
From the previous iteration these are more comfortable, and with an upper that really embraces the foot. Previous were too firm - like wearing a shell. They're true to size, but on the roomier side in the toebox.

The weight's gone up noticeably.
The structure of the midsole is too uniform, making them really non sensitive to the anatomy and biomechanics of the foot. Under the weight, the midsole expands evenly.

The real disadvantage and serious drawback is the insole + midsole shape. The main support is on the outer edge of the foot, instead of supporting the arch. This really encourages foot pronation and is something that's been always bad about Downshifter.

Quality:The shoes are made from durable, high-quality materials with excellent stitching and a sturdy sole.
Suitability:The shoes are appropriate for their intended purpose (walking, sports, or daily wear). It provide good comfort and support, although they may not be ideal for all weather conditions or specialized activities.
Appearance:The shoes have an attractive, modern design with a clean finish.

I really love this shoes and i get it at a lower price because it’s sale during 7.7. Very comfy and i cant wait to use it on my running era. Thanks Shopee!
